set-variable.value: #[do { var h = attributes.headers.'x-correlation-id' default '' --- if (h matches /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}$/) h else correlationId }]

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.start", tool: vars.toolName, correlationId: vars.traceId}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

#[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.success", tool: vars.toolName, correlationId: vars.traceId, propertyCode: payload.meta.property_code, totalResults: payload.meta.total_results, elapsedMs: (now() as Number {unit: "milliseconds"}) - vars.startedAt}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

set-variable.value: Request body must be valid JSON.

raise-error.description: Request body is not valid JSON

http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { version: p('t03.version'), language: vars.servicesRequest.language, channel: p('t03.channel'), propertyCode: vars.servicesRequest.propertyCode, checkin: vars.servicesRequest.checkin, checkout: vars.servicesRequest.checkout, adults: vars.servicesRequest.adults, children: vars.servicesRequest.children, currency: p('default.currency') }]

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.property.response", tool: vars.toolName, correlationId: vars.traceId, status: attributes.statusCode, topLevel: if (payload is Object) (keysOf(payload) map ($ as String)) else typeOf(payload) as String, propertyListSize: if (payload.propertyList is Array) sizeOf(payload.propertyList) else null, facilityFields: if (vars.servicesSource.facilities is Object) (keysOf(vars.servicesSource.facilities) map ($ as String)) else typeOf(vars.servicesSource.facilities) as String}, "application/json", {indent: false})]
#[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.property.response", correlationId: vars.traceId, note: "response body is not readable JSON"}, "application/json", {indent: false})]
